pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pCollects pear/diamond tree products into its bulk bins when its adjacent tree satisfies the program.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place beside the three-block trunk, facing away.$p2. Maintain a valid tree with the required leaf count.$p3. Let leaves mature and withdraw products from the bins.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pThis collects configured tree products, not arbitrary drops from any modded tree.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
